title: Maria Jose made our Enchanted Seville tour unforgettable
text:
We booked the Enchanted Seville walking tour expecting a nice overview of the city, but Maria Jose made it so much more than that. From the moment she introduced herself, her warmth and genuine love for Seville were obvious. She didn’t just recite dates and facts - she told stories that made the narrow streets, hidden plazas, and old walls come alive. You could tell she truly cares about sharing her city with visitors.
 
What stood out most was how she balanced history with local legends and personal anecdotes. She kept the whole group engaged, answered every random question with a smile. 
 
H

title: Stories or legends: the magic of Seville
text: We had an excellent guide: Majo. It was a very pleasant experience, touring the Jewish quarter, squares, streets (Street of Life, Street of Death, Cabeza del Rey Don Pedro Street), places full of stories: we talked about Susona, Pedro the Cruel or the Just (everything can have two sides, depending on who tells it), the Guzmanes, Murillo, Justa and Rufina... ; about Roman, Muslim, and Christian Seville; and even about the ghosts of the Faculty of. Fine Arts of the University of Seville. Everything narrated in an enjoyable way by Majo.
